title: The Part-Time Parliament — Paxos
description: Leslie Lamport's Paxos paper: a round hall, a handful of legislators who keep wandering off, and the ballot that still gets them to agree.
question: How can a group of machines agree on a sequence of commands when any of them may wander off at any time, and no one is in charge for long?
how: Lamport answered this himself, with the part-time legislators of the Greek island of Paxos. We present his paper as he wrote it, with interactive figures. It is the paper that inspired this entire project. Lamport ends it with the parliament's fall; the other books set that aside, and in them the parliament is still sitting.
